issue.title: Worker does not reconnect after broker restart
issue.body: Restart the local broker while the worker is processing messages. The worker remains disconnected after the broker returns. The integration test tests/test_broker.py::test_reconnect_after_restart exercises this transition.

commands.output:
ERROR at setup of test_reconnect_after_restart
DockerException: Error while fetching server API version: ConnectionRefusedError(111, Connection refused)
The broker fixture did not start; no worker restart assertions ran.

repository_excerpts.tests/AGENTS.md: The reconnect gate uses the real broker container through the runner-owned Docker service. Mocks do not establish restart behavior.
